Projects

Each entry states what the system is, its current status and the engineering capability it demonstrates.

  • 5 documented systems

The aerial programme

One programme across two competition cycles. The 2026 system is the foundation the 2027 system is built on — stated in that order because that is how the work runs.

The aerial programme

Two cycles, one spine. The second is built on the first by design.

  1. 01NIDAR 2026Built

    Autonomous Unmanned Aerial System

    A fully integrated unmanned aerial system, designed and built end to end: airframe, embedded electronics, flight controller integration, mission planning, payload management and autonomous flight.

    The problem
    Documented engineering scope: bringing airframe design, embedded electronics, flight control, mission planning and payload management into one autonomous system.
    Why it matters
    Represents KAALKRIT’s full-lifecycle work across design, integration, software, testing and autonomous flight.
    Capabilities
    Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Systems · Flight Control & Autonomous Navigation · Embedded Systems Development · Mechanical Design & Rapid Prototyping · PCB Design & Electronics
  2. 02NIDAR 2027In development

    AirMOS

    Currently in development; advanced sensing, autonomy and mission-oriented design.

    The problem
    Documented engineering scope: advanced sensing, autonomy and mission-oriented design for the next aerial programme cycle.
    Why it matters
    Continues the NIDAR aerial programme into 2027.
    Capabilities
    Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Systems · Intelligent Drone Technologies · Flight Control & Autonomous Navigation · Sensor Integration & Control Systems · Artificial Intelligence & Computer Vision
